title: Input schema for Pry GPU Cloud Price Watch
description: Track GPU rental prices and availability - H100, A100, H200 - across RunPod, Lambda, Vast.ai and CoreWeave. GPU price snapshots pulled hourly for ML cost optimization and capacity planning.

change_threshold.title: Change threshold
change_threshold.description: SimHash bit distance above this counts as changed (0 = any difference, 3 default, 10+ only major rewrites).

urls.title: Target URLs
urls.description: One or more https:// URLs to process.

gpu_models.title: GPU models
gpu_models.description: Filter to these GPU model names (e.g. H100, A100).

max_items.title: Max items (cost cap)
max_items.description: Hard cap on processed items for this run - keeps trial costs predictable. Billing stops when the cap or your spending limit is reached.

proxy_configuration.title: Proxy configuration
proxy_configuration.description: Apify proxy settings passed through to Pry's premium-proxy tier. Leave default to use the platform proxy automatically.
